question.en: What evidence is there of a ghost?

sentences.en: What evidence is there of a ghost?
A public house which was recently bought by Mr.Ian Thompson is up for sale.
sentences.zh: 伊恩·汤普森先生最近买下的一家小酒馆现在要出售。

sentences.en: Mr.Thompson is going to sell it because it is haunted.
sentences.zh: 汤普森先生打算卖掉它，因为这里闹鬼。

sentences.en: He told me that he could not go to sleep one night
sentences.zh: 他告诉我有天晚上他睡不着，

sentences.en: because he heard a strange noise coming from the bar.
sentences.zh: 因为他听到酒吧里传出奇怪的声音。

sentences.en: he found that the doors had been blocked by chairs and the furniture had been moved.
sentences.zh: 他发现门被椅子堵住了，家具也被挪动过。

sentences.en: Though Mr.Thompson had turned the lights off before he went to bed,
sentences.zh: 虽然汤普森先生睡觉前把灯关了，

sentences.en: they were on in the morning.
sentences.zh: 可第二天早上灯却亮着。

sentences.en: He also said that he had found five empty whisky bottles
sentences.zh: 他还说发现了五只空的威士忌酒瓶，

sentences.en: which the ghost must have drunk the night before.
sentences.zh: 这肯定是鬼在前一天晚上喝的。

sentences.en: When I suggested that some villagers must have come in for a free drink, Mr.Thompson shook his head.
sentences.zh: 当我暗示说一定是村民进来喝免费的酒时，汤普森先生摇了摇头。

sentences.en: The villagers have told him that they will not accept the pub even if he gives it away.
sentences.zh: 村民们告诉他，即使他把酒馆白送，他们也不要。
